headline: Approved 32-unit NS Fernbank Road development, digital billboard at 2100 Roosevelt Avenue, and zoning changes; denied 139 Paramount Street permit amendment.
summary: Housing Director Gerry McCafferty presented the New Springfield Housing and Neighborhood Revitalization Plan. The council also amended three special permits for 47 Colton Street and passed a resolution urging state lawmakers to keep $1 million for the city's housing strategy.
decisions: Approved resolution urging state bond bill conference committee to keep $1 million for city housing strategy, 10-0.
Denied amendment to special permit at 139 Paramount Street for motor vehicle sales, 0-10.
Approved special permit for 32-unit residential development on NS Fernbank Road, 10-0.
Approved amending three special permits at 47 Colton Street and a change in petitioner, 10-0.
Approved converting static billboard to digital billboard at 2100 Roosevelt Avenue, 10-0.
Approved zone change for NS Fernbank Road from Residence B and Business A to Residence C, 10-0.
Approved amendments to Springfield Zoning Ordinance Articles 2, 4, 5, 7 and 9, 10-0.

plain_text:
City Council  
     
Regular Meeting 
 
~Final~ 
   
 
36 Court Street  
Springfield, MA 01103   
http://www.springfieldcityhall.com 
 
Gladys Oyola-Lopez 
 
November 23, 
2026 
6:30 PM City Hall - Room 200 
 
 
 
Roll Call 
COUNCILORS BROWN, GOVAN AND WALSH WERE ABSENT.  COUNCILOR HURST 
WAS REMOTE FOR THIS MEETING. 
Moment Of Silence - Pledge Of Allegiance 
 
Informational 
 1. The New Springfield Housing and Neighborhood Revitalization Plan 
HOUSING DIRECTOR, GERRY MCCAFFERTY MADE THE PRESENTATION.  THIS 
WAS ALSO PRESENTED TO THE COMMITTEE OF THE WHOLE ON 11/18. 
COUNCILOR SANTAIELLO INQUIRED WHY WE WERE LOWEST IN THE REGION. 
 THE LESS REINVESTMENT AND CONDITIONS OF PROPERTIES ARE REASONS.  THE 
DIRECTOR DID NOT KNOW THE EXACT PERCENTAGE OF OUTSIDE OWNERS OR 
RENTAL PROPERTIES. 
 
AYES Brian Santaniello, Gerry Martin, Maria Perez, Justin Hurst, Victor 
Davila, Michael Fenton, Jose Delgado, Lavar Click-Bruce, Melvin 
Edwards, Tracye Whitfield 
NAYS None 
AWAY None 
RECUSE None 
ABSTAIN None 
ABSENT Malo Brown, Zaida Govan, Kateri Walsh
Resolution 
 2. A Resolution Urging The Massachusetts Economic Development Bond Bill Conference 
Committee to Retain One Million Dollars in Funding For The City of Springfield Housing 
Strategy  
VICE PRESIDENT DELGADO TOOK THE CHAIR, SO PRESIDENT WHITFIELD COULD 
READ THE RESOLUTION INTO THE RECORD. 
COUNCILOR SANTANIELLO POINTED OUT THAT THE SPRINGFIELD DELGATION 
HAS SIGNED ON TO THIS AND HE IS HAPPY TO SUPPORT. 
 
AYES Brian Santaniello, Gerry Martin, Maria Perez, Justin Hurst, Victor 
Davila, Michael Fenton, Jose Delgado, Lavar Click-Bruce, Melvin 
Edwards, Tracye Whitfield 
NAYS None 
AWAY None 
RECUSE None 
ABSTAIN None 
ABSENT Malo Brown, Zaida Govan, Kateri Walsh 
 
Special Permits 
 3. 139 Paramount Street – Amend Existing Special Permit (Motor Vehicle Sales) 
THE PETITIONER HAS NOT SHOWN UP FOR 3 MEETINGS.  COUNCILOR FENTON 
SPOKE ON THE SPECIAL PERMIT AND ASKED FOR A VOTE NO. 
KATHY BROWN SPOKE REPRESENTING THE EAST SPRINGFIELD NEIGHBORHOOD 
COUNCIL AGAINST THE SPECIAL PERMIT. 
 
AYES None 
NAYS Brian Santaniello, Gerry Martin, Maria Perez, Justin Hurst, Victor 
Davila, Michael Fenton, Jose Delgado, Lavar Click-Bruce, Melvin 
Edwards, Tracye Whitfield 
AWAY None 
RECUSE None 
ABSTAIN None 
ABSENT Malo Brown, Zaida Govan, Kateri Walsh 
 4. NS Fernbank Road - Residential Development (32 units)
ATTORNEY RACHEL FANCY PRESENTED THE 32 UNIT PROPOSAL FOR THE 
SPECIAL PERMIT. BOTH INDIAN ORCHARD AND SIXTEEN ACRES 
NEIGHBORHOODS HAVE APPROVED, AS WELL AS THE PLANNING BOARD. 
ELIDIX RODRIGUEZ OF SPRINGFIELD STATED THAT THERE IS FLOODING IN THIS 
AREA  AND ASKED THE DEVELOPER IF THEY HAD A PLAN TO ADDRESS THE 
FLOODING.  ROB LEVESQUE, THE ARCHITECT FOR THE PROJECT, STATED THAT 
ALL THE WATER ON SITE WILL BE HANDLED BOTH BEFORE AND AFTER THE 
PROJECT.  
COUNCILOR SANTANIELLO HAS A COUPLE OF CLARIFYING QUESTIONS. 
COUNCILOR FENTON IS IN SUPPORT OF THE PROJECT. 
 
AYES Brian Santaniello, Gerry Martin, Maria Perez, Justin Hurst, Victor 
Davila, Michael Fenton, Jose Delgado, Lavar Click-Bruce, Melvin 
Edwards, Tracye Whitfield 
NAYS None 
AWAY None 
RECUSE None 
ABSTAIN None 
ABSENT Malo Brown, Zaida Govan, Kateri Walsh 
 5. 47 Colton Street — Amending three special permits (motor vehicle sales, repairs & autobody) 
and change in petitioner 
LOUIS DARLEY OF 47 MOTORS ON COLTON STREET IS THE PETITIONER AND 
PRESENTED THE SPECIAL PERMIT. 
COUNCILOR SANTANIELLO ASKED FOR CLARIFICATION ON THE WORK DONE AT 
THE PROPERTY.  THE PETITIONER RESPONDED. 
 
AYES Brian Santaniello, Gerry Martin, Maria Perez, Justin Hurst, Victor 
Davila, Michael Fenton, Jose Delgado, Lavar Click-Bruce, Melvin 
Edwards, Tracye Whitfield 
NAYS None 
AWAY None 
RECUSE None 
ABSTAIN None 
ABSENT Malo Brown, Zaida Govan, Kateri Walsh 
 6. 2100 Roosevelt Avenue — Digital Billboard 
ATTORNEY DAN FINNEGAN AND PAT KEOUGH PRESENTED THE CONVERSION OF
A STATIC BILLBOARD TO A DIGITAL BILLBOARD.  KATHLEEN BROWN, EAST 
SPRINGFIELD NEIGHBORHOOD COUNCIL PRESIDENT HAS APPROVED THE 
CONVERSION. 
COUNCILOR SANTANIELLO HAS DONE RESEARCH ON DIGITAL BILLBOARDS AND 
HE IS IN FAVOR. 
COUNCILOR FENTON IS ALSO IN FAVOR. 
 
AYES Brian Santaniello, Gerry Martin, Maria Perez, Justin Hurst, Victor 
Davila, Michael Fenton, Jose Delgado, Lavar Click-Bruce, Melvin 
Edwards, Tracye Whitfield 
NAYS None 
AWAY None 
RECUSE None 
ABSTAIN None 
ABSENT Malo Brown, Zaida Govan, Kateri Walsh 
 
Zone Changes 
 7. Zone Change — NS Fernbank Road from Residence B & Business A to Residence C 
ATTORNEY RACHEL FANCY PRESENTED THE ZONE CHANGE BEFORE THE 
SPECIAL PERMIT.  A ZONE CHANGE IS NEEDED TO MOVE FORWARD WITH THE 
SPECIAL PERMIT. 
COUNCILOR MARTIN ASKED WHAT NEIGHBORHOODS APPROVED.  ATTORNEY 
FANCY NOTED THAT BOTH INDIAN ORCHARD AND SIXTEEN ACRES 
NEIGHBORHOODS HAVE APPROVED. 
COUNCILOR SANTANIELLO ASKED IF ONYX BORROWED 8 MILLION DOLLARS 
FROM SPRINGFIELD BEFORE SELLING THE MALL.  ATTORNEYS STRATTON AND 
FANCY PROVIDED CLARIFICATION.  COUNCILORS FENTON AND DAVILA ASKED 
FOR ADDITIONAL CLARIFICATION ON THE PARCEL OWNERSHIP. 
 
AYES Brian Santaniello, Gerry Martin, Maria Perez, Justin Hurst, Victor 
Davila, Michael Fenton, Jose Delgado, Lavar Click-Bruce, Melvin 
Edwards, Tracye Whitfield 
NAYS None 
AWAY None 
RECUSE None 
ABSTAIN None
ABSENT Malo Brown, Zaida Govan, Kateri Walsh 
 8. Amending Springfield Zoning Ordinance Article #'s 2, 4, 5, 7 & 9 
DIRECTOR OF PLANNING, PHIL DROMEY PRESENTED THE ZONE CHANGE THAT 
CONTINUED FROM LAST MEETING.  VERIFIED WITH ZONING THAT ONE 
POLITICAL SIGN PER CANDIDATE IS ALLOWED. 
COUNCILOR MARTIN IS IN SUPPORT OF THE ZONE CHANGE, ESPECIALLY FOR 
THE DATA CENTER DEFINITION. 
COUNCILOR HURST AGREES WITH COUNCILOR MARTIN. 
COUNCILOR SANTANIELLO IS WORKING WITH THE LAW DEPARTMENT FOR A 
MORATORIUM FOR DATA CENTERS. 
COUNCILOR DAVILA WANTED CLARIFICATION ON THE TRAILERS. 
 
AYES Brian Santaniello, Gerry Martin, Maria Perez, Justin Hurst, Victor 
Davila, Michael Fenton, Jose Delgado, Lavar Click-Bruce, Melvin 
Edwards, Tracye Whitfield 
NAYS None 
AWAY None 
RECUSE None 
ABSTAIN None 
ABSENT Malo Brown, Zaida Govan, Kateri Walsh
